status: Proposed set (FLG-008, question Q-05). Client code records these only when analyticsEndpoint is set in config.json.
privacy: No cookies, no IP address stored, no user-agent stored, no fingerprinting. Browsers that send Do Not Track are not counted. Counts are aggregated per day.

events.name: product_view
events.fires: When a product row or card is shown on a page (once per page load).

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires: When a reader clicks a product link. The link itself is not redirected; the browser goes straight to the Amazon URL.

events.name: guide_read_75
events.fires: When a reader scrolls past 75% of a guide.

why_no_redirect: Associates Program Policies (v) prohibit cloaking the URL of a Site with Special Links, including by use of Redirecting Links (S02). The click counter therefore records the click in the browser and lets the link go directly to Amazon.
